resource_load.note: 1 git commit lookup + 2 user lookups by email + optional file status + optional diff stats

performance_issues.description: User lookup by email is done on every request without caching (no userCache passed for single commit)
performance_issues.impact: 2 DB queries per request for author/committer lookup
performance_issues.recommendation: Consider caching user-by-email lookups in a request-scoped or short-TTL cache

optimization_recommendations.description: Disable stat/files/verification by default for high-frequency API consumers
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Eliminates git diff-tree and GPG verification per request
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Already supported via query params; document recommendation for clients

resource_load.note: 1 git rev-list --count + 1 git log + N user lookups (cached) + optional N file statuses + optional N diff stats

performance_issues.description: For each commit in the page, ToCommit is called which may trigger file status and diff stat git operations
performance_issues.impact: With default options (stat=true, files=true), up to 50 commits × 2 git operations = 100 git subprocess calls per request
performance_issues.code_snippet: apiCommits[i], err = convert.ToCommit(ctx, ctx.Repo.Repository, ctx.Repo.GitRepo, commit, userCache, convert.ParseCommitOptions(ctx))
performance_issues.recommendation: Batch file status and diff stat operations, or document that clients should disable stat/files for large listings

performance_issues.description: CommitsCount runs git rev-list --count on every request without caching
performance_issues.impact: For large repos, rev-list --count can be slow (seconds for repos with millions of commits)
performance_issues.recommendation: Cache commit counts for default branch with short TTL

optimization_recommendations.description: Batch git operations for file status and diff stats instead of per-commit subprocess calls
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Could reduce git subprocess calls from 100+ to 2-3 per request
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Use git log --stat or git log --name-status with pagination to get all info in one call

optimization_recommendations.description: Cache commit count for default branch
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Eliminates expensive rev-list --count for common case
optimization_recommendations.implementation: In-memory cache with invalidation on push

resource_load.note: 1 commit resolve + 1 git diff/format-patch streamed to response

performance_issues.description: Diff output is streamed without size limit - large commits could produce very large responses
performance_issues.impact: Memory and bandwidth consumption for commits touching many files
performance_issues.recommendation: Consider adding a size limit or warning header for very large diffs
